title: Endorsement
description: Definition of Endorsement under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: any message, verbal statement, demonstration; or depiction of the name, signature, likeness or other identifiable personal characteristics of an individual; or depiction of the name or seal of any institution or organisation, which makes the consumer to believe that it reflects the opinion, finding or experience of the person making such endorsement
content.plain_language: a public statement or action that supports a product or service, making it seem like it's approved or recommended by someone or an organization
examples: A celebrity appearing in a commercial for a new energy drink
A company logo displayed on a product packaging, implying endorsement by that company
non_examples: A company simply listing its ingredients on a product label
A customer review that is clearly labeled as an independent opinion

user_queries: What is an endorsement in advertising
